title: Postgres as a queue: the load test that found the wall
story: A team runs its job queue on a Postgres table with SKIP LOCKED and ramps a load test to see where it breaks. The first two stages pass easily, then something quiet starts piling up. Compressed: 1 s ≈ 4 s.

title: The rebalance storm: when slow looks dead
story: A payments team consumes an orders topic with three workers. A database migration makes each record slower to process. Nobody's consumer crashes, yet within minutes the group is stuck in a loop of rebalances and lag is climbing.

title: 7 million tables a day: Zerodha's report cache
story: Every report a Zerodha user pulls becomes its own Postgres table, about 7 million by midnight, all thrown away at 02:00. Follow tax-deadline day, compressed (≈6 min per second by day, 1 min per second in the evening rush).

title: Load test until it breaks: the three walls of a Kafka cluster
story: A team ramps a healthy 3-broker Kafka cluster from 20 to 270 MB/s with the abort guard switched off, to learn exactly how it fails. Compressed: 1 s of playback ≈ 10 s of test time.
